tool.name: MakePlumed
tool.description: Generate PLUMED input for biased dynamics using an MDAE model.

param.name: input_model_pth_path
param.help: Path to the trained PyTorch model (.pth) to be converted to TorchScript and used in PLUMED

param.name: input_stats_pt_path
param.help: Path to statistics file (.pt) produced during featurization, used to derive the PLUMED features.dat content

param.name: input_reference_pdb_path
param.help: Path to reference PDB used for FIT_TO_TEMPLATE actions when Cartesian features are present

param.name: input_ndx_path
param.help: Path to GROMACS index (NDX) file used to define groups when required by PLUMED

param.name: outname_output_plumed_dat_path
param.help: Path to the output PLUMED input file

param.name: outname_output_features_dat_path
param.help: Path to the output features.dat file describing the CVs to PLUMED

param.name: outname_output_model_ptc_path
param.help: Path to the output TorchScript model file (.ptc) for PLUMED's PYTORCH_MODEL action

param.name: config_json
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax
